initialFullContext.title: Which first?
initialFullContext.raw: {"why":"Our moot hall is now too small for the town we have become, and I think we need to plan for that. There is also a summer fair the merchants and the Festival Society have been asking for. I am the steward, and I want to be fair to both: a proper town hall would cost 1,957 coin and give us a fine centre, while a summer fair would cost 272 coin and bring visitors who spend. Which should come first, the town hall or the fair? That is your decision to make."}

initialFullContext.title: Guild seats, or an exchange hall
initialFullContext.raw: {"why":"The Craft Guild wants guild seats, so our makers have a real voice in the council. The Merchant Exchange wants an exchange hall, which would cost 1,601 coin and could help trade grow. You can back one, or back neither, and whichever you choose the other will be sore. I speak for the guild and I'd rather you choose the seats first, since the makers feel unheard. Which should come first, the guild seats or the exchange hall?"}

initialFullContext.title: The Merchant Exchange has lost heart
initialFullContext.raw: {"why":"I'm a merchant, and I have to say it plainly: the Merchant Exchange has lost heart. initialFullContext.title: Which first?
initialFullContext.raw: {"why":"I'm a merchant, quick and keen to see us grow, and I need your decision. The big farms are ready to put their money into fenced fields, which would grow more grain, and more boats come into port every year.
